name: Bayesian LASSO for QTL mapping

prior: Independent zero-mean normal effect priors with exponential variance mixing (double-exponential marginal); gamma hyperprior for shrinkage; residual-independent and residual-dependent alternatives.
inference_algorithm: MCMC cycling through conditional posterior distributions of all unknowns.
estimand: Posterior means or medians and intervals for marker effects and per-effect heritability.
data_input: Individual quantitative phenotypes and genome-wide marker genotypes; primarily two-genotype mapping populations; missing genotypes replaced by conditional expectations.
tunable_settings: Gamma hyperprior shape a and inverse scale b (example 0.1 each); residual-independent versus dependent prior; MCMC chain length, thinning and convergence diagnostic threshold.
